NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | Commit history: squashed from 4 to 2 commits, but the titles are still "fix for issue 17419" and "added test case for issue 17418" (wrong issue number, no area prefix), and the test is in a separate commit from the fix |
| ✅  | Self-review checklist now matches the PR template |
| ❌  | Precise before/after screenshots: nothing new was added, and the author argues none are possible. The change does alter rendered output (tabs vs. spaces), which the existing editor-based screenshots already show |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown from the input |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the commit messages and structure and to redo the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for squashing the commits! The titles still don't follow our [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html) (area prefix, imperative summary, correct issue number), and the test should go in the same commit as the fix. Also, this change is visible in the rendered code block, so please add precise before/after screenshots following [this guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots), for example the same message with whitespace shown in both.
```
